App.Name: Dofus Companion
App.Disclaimer: Independent tool, not affiliated with or authorised by Ankama. It never acts in the game: you play, it informs.
Main.ToggleOverlayTip: Shows or hides the always-on-top panel.
Overlay.Title: Dofus Companion — overlay
Overlay.SearchTip: Type a name or alias (accents and case ignored). Enter = first result.
Overlay.NoResult: No entity found in the local database.
Overlay.Empty: Search an entity or import a screenshot to show its mechanics.
Overlay.CaptureTip: Capture the screen now (local analysis, single image)
Overlay.CompactTip: Switch between compact and detailed mode
Overlay.TurnTip: Current game turn, entered by you. Used to evaluate turn conditions (even, from turn N…). Empty = unknown.
Overlay.ClickThroughOn: Click-through is on: the overlay ignores the mouse. Press {0} to take control back.
Browser.Search: Search by name, alias, state, effect…
Browser.SearchTip: Local, accent-insensitive search. Also searches mechanic text (states, triggers).
Browser.NoResult: No result for "{0}". The entity may not be in the database yet.
Detail.Empty: Select an entity to show its information.
Detail.NoMechanicBody: The local database has no verified mechanic for this entity. Nothing is made up: add one with its source (Knowledge tab) or import a package.
Detail.NotEstablished: Unconfirmed information: check in game or in the source.
Detail.CopyCompactTip: Copies the ordered summary to the clipboard.
Detail.RosterCompleteTip: Tick if every monster present has been recognized: a monster's absence can then be taken into account.
Stale.SourcePredatesGameVersion: Source older than the reference game version: {0}
Analysis.PasteTip: Analyses the clipboard image (e.g. after Win+Shift+S).
Analysis.CaptureTip: Single capture of the screen showing the overlay, analysed locally. Enable it in Settings.
Analysis.CaptureOff: Screen capture is disabled (Settings › Capture & privacy). File import and paste always work.
Analysis.Privacy: 100% local analysis: the image is not sent anywhere and not kept (unless you enable it).
Analysis.NoImage:
No image.
Import a file, paste a capture (Ctrl+V after Win+Shift+S) or enable screen capture.
Analysis.RegionHint: Drag on the image to read only a region.
Analysis.NoClipboardImage: The clipboard does not contain an image.
Analysis.CaptureDisabled: Screen capture is disabled. Enable it in Settings › Capture & privacy.
Analysis.NeedsConfirmation: Possible match: confirm the right candidate.
Analysis.Ambiguous: Several equally plausible candidates: pick the right one, nothing was selected automatically.
Analysis.NoMatch: No known entity recognized. Pick it manually below or crop the image.
Analysis.ScoreMeaning: The score measures how closely the text read matches a known name (100% = identical). It is not a probability.
Analysis.ManualTip: If recognition is wrong, search the right entity here.
Analysis.AliasLearned: "{0}" saved as a local alias of {1}.
Knowledge.ImportHelp: JSON packages are validated (schema + consistency) before any change. You see the exact effect before applying; verified or user-edited data is never overwritten without your consent.
Knowledge.PreviewReady: Preview ready: review the changes before applying.
Editor.Title: Create or edit
Editor.Help: A mechanic must cite a source. Only mark "Verified" what you checked in the source. One line = one item.
Editor.Name: Canonical name
Editor.SourceRequired: Pick a source: a mechanic without a source is not accepted.
Editor.VerifiedNeedsSource: A "Verified" entity must cite a source.
Editor.PickEntity: Pick or save the entity first.
Editor.BadUrl: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
Settings.SavedRestart: Settings saved. The new database location will be used at next start.
Settings.NoActivateHelp: The game keeps the keyboard even when you click the overlay. Typing in the overlay search then becomes impossible: use the main window.
Settings.ShortcutsHelp: Format: "Ctrl+Shift+F9". A modifier is required. Avoid combinations other programs use: a global shortcut takes them away. These shortcuts only control Dofus Companion, never the game. Leave empty to disable.
Settings.OcrVariants: Try several preprocessing steps if the first read fails
Settings.CaptureEnabled: Allow on-demand screen capture (off by default)
Settings.CaptureHelp: One image of the screen, only when you click or press the shortcut, analysed locally. No access to the game process. Exclusive-fullscreen games may produce a black image: use borderless windowed mode.
Settings.ExcludeOverlay: Hide the overlay from Dofus Companion's own captures (it stays visible in Discord, OBS…)
Settings.SaveObservations: Keep recognition history (text and candidates, no image)
Settings.LearnCorrections: Learn from my confirmations (adds local aliases)
Settings.DatabaseHelp: Takes effect at next start. An empty database automatically receives the bundled verified data.
Settings.BadDatabasePath: The database file must have the .db extension.
Diag.ExportReview: Review the report before saving or sharing it
Diag.CaptureOk: GDI BitBlt available; overlay capture exclusion supported (Windows 10 2004+)
Diag.CaptureOld: Windows too old to exclude the overlay from captures
Error.Seed: The base data could not be installed: {0}
Error.DatabaseMigration:
The knowledge database could not be upgraded: {0}

Nothing was changed. Update the application or restore a backup.
Error.HotkeyConflict: Shortcut {0} ({1}) is already used by another program. Change it in Settings.
Error.ImageFormat: Unsupported image format (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF).
